about: Starter places for Las Vegas and Henderson. Coordinates are from OpenStreetMap. Nothing here is a Yelp, Google, Olive, or Seed Oil Scout score. Community reports are not invented; the reports array is empty until someone pastes real ones. Hours change.

places.name: Ethel M Chocolates Factory, Flagship Store, and Cactus Garden
places.address: 2 Cactus Garden Drive, Henderson, NV 89014
places.hoursNote: Copied from the official flagship page on November 10, 2026: open daily 9am–7pm. The page also says factory production viewing is generally Monday–Friday 10am–3:30pm, while the viewing aisle is accessible when the store is open. Hours change.
places.summary: Ethel M’s Henderson factory, flagship shop, and cactus garden, at the address on the company’s location page. The page says chocolates are made in small batches with no artificial flavors or colors, and colors from natural sources. It does not print ingredient lists or a cooking fat for the cafe, so Tortuga does not turn that into a chocolate score.

offerings.name: Chocolate dipped strawberry
offerings.note: Listed on the flagship cafe menu as a strawberry dipped in milk or dark chocolate. Ingredients are not printed there.

offerings.name: Caramel and chocolate dipped apple

sourcedNotes.text: The flagship page says the chocolates are made in small batches with no artificial flavors or colors, and colors derived from natural sources.

places.name: True Food Kitchen, Forum Shops
places.address: 3500 S Las Vegas Boulevard, Space R-15A, Las Vegas, NV 89109
places.hoursNote: Copied from the company’s Las Vegas order page on November 10, 2026: Sunday 9:30am–9pm, Monday–Thursday 11am–9pm, Friday 11am–10pm, Saturday 9:30am–10pm. Hours change.
places.coordinateNote: The pin is the OpenStreetMap node named True Food Kitchen at the Forum Shops. The suite number is from the company’s location page, not from that map node.
places.summary: True Food Kitchen inside the Forum Shops. The company’s own seed-oil page says its restaurants cook with avocado oil and olive oil and that 98% of kitchen ingredients are seed oil-free. A different company page says the chain is 100% seed oil-free and still working through ingredients. Tortuga keeps both sentences and does not treat the kitchen as finished or approved.

sourcedNotes.text: True Food Kitchen’s seed-oil page says the company cooks exclusively with avocado and olive oils, and that 98% of the ingredients used in its kitchens are seed oil-free. The company story page says the chain is 100% seed oil-free and that it switched in 2022 to cooking exclusively with avocado and olive oils while still eliminating seed oils from ingredients. Those two pages do not use the same figure.
